title: My opinion
description: Express what you think and agree or disagree politely.

introduction.headline: Share your point of view
introduction.body: Learn phrases to give opinions, support your ideas, and respond to others respectfully.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara frasi per esprimere opinioni, sostenere le tue idee e rispondere con rispetto.
objectives: Use I think / In my opinion

vocabulary.example: In my opinion, remote work is better.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Secondo me, il lavoro da remoto è meglio.
Tuttavia, capisco il tuo punto di vista.

exercises.explanation: In my opinion is a common way to share your view.

exercises.prompt: I ____ with you on this point.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: I ____ with you on this point.
exercises.explanation: Agree with means to share the same view.

review.tip: Practise giving your opinion on a film or restaurant in two sentences.
